text.content:
Passages fork here into the Forsaken heart of the Crypts, worn smooth by traffic that wasn't always living.

GM Notes

Clue: A clue toward the floor's deeper story: Something in the Crypts below is calling the recently dead home, one grave at a time.

Encounter: A patrol or wandering hazard tied to the floor's threat passes through this area on a rotation; a failed Perception check meets it head-on.
